t.en: Two values made by the same constructor are equal only if their arguments are: if S a = S b, then a = b. This is <wiki-ref to="injectivity"></wiki-ref>. The declaration does not give it as a rule; it is proved with the help of a function, pred, the number before a number.
t.zh: 同一个构造子造出的两个值相等，参数也相等：S a = S b，则 a = b。这叫<wiki-ref to="injectivity"></wiki-ref>。声明没有直接给出这条规则，要借一个函数证出来：pred 取一个数的前一个。

after.en: The one-to-one proved goes into the “Rule book of numbers”. In Lean’s kernel the same fact is called noConfusion.
after.zh: 证出的一对一进了「数理规则书」。Lean 的内核里，同一件事叫 noConfusion。

brief.en: Write a right side for every row.
From the definition of pred, prove: if S x = S y, then x = y.
brief.zh: 从 pred 的定义证出：若 S x = S y，则 x = y。

hint.en: Take a, and then b, in pred’s definition.
hint.zh: pred 的定义分别取 a 和 b。

hint.en: The assumed S a = S b can rewrite one of them.
hint.zh: 假设的 S a = S b 可以改写其中一句。
